SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16)

FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2)

THIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 10)

• Bedroom 3: Queen Guest Suite (sleeps 4) Two Queen Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Double Sink Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower
• Bedroom 4: Bunk Room: (sleeps 4) Two Twin over Twin Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom with Single Sink Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower

FOURTH FLOOR (Sleeps 4)
• Bedroom 5: Primary King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Tile/Glass Shower & Soaking Tub + Shared Balcony
• Bedroom 6: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Dual Sink Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower

Exquisitely curated in modern coastal design, Emerald Le Luxe is a thoughtfully designed luxury residence featuring breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico through the huge windows framing every inch of the gorgeous water views. Only minutes from Rosemary Beach this vacation haven is within the perfect proximity of privacy yet close enough to the excitement of 30A.
Newly built, this coastal retreat is characterized by completely unobstructed Gulf views with prominent positioning on one of the best lots on 30A created by a corner lot with protected dunes to the side. This exceptional property is steps away from the glittering, jewel-toned Gulf waters and sandy white beaches. The close walkover will take you directly to the water and miles of sugar white sandy beaches!

This new construction residence features over 6,875 square feet of pristine living space spanning an impressive four-story vertical footprint. Notable features include a second story pool, private elevator, luxurious crown molding and wood flooring throughout and privacy fencing.

The expansive floor plan incorporates six bedrooms and six and a half baths, with gorgeous white interior and floor-to-ceiling windows and a seamless integration of the indoor/ outdoor living experience with covered balconies perfect for sipping a cocktail or enjoying a morning coffee on every floor.

On the first floor, guests will enjoy luxurious master king suite, complete with French doors that lead to a large, covered patio facing the Gulf and completely complimented by the ensuite bathroom with modern-meets-coastal design reflected in white marble accents, a large soaking tub and beautiful chandelier. Also, on the first floor guests can enjoy the billiard room.

The second floor unveils the focal point of the open concept living space. The cutting-edge, modern design extends into the kitchen and dining area with crisp white cabinetry, a luxury island, brand-new appliances, and custom light fixtures. The second-floor design is indulgently completed with an ultra-modern resort pool and deck area framed with coastal views.

The third level offers spectacular unobstructed gulf views highlighted with a game room and sleeping space in three additional guest suites including a king bedroom, two queen bedrooms, and a bunk room with four twin-over-twin bunks. Each has a private bath with spacious walk-in showers.

The fourth level invites privacy with two king suites complimented by private adjoining baths – one with its own shower, and one with separate tub and shower.

Enjoy exploring the area on the six-seater golf cart provided with the property or enhance your 30A experience with a local favorite and take to the trails on 6 adult bikes included with your stay.
Filled with thoughtfully chosen details and luscious calming neutral tones, this home is simply stunning and gives the serenity you have been craving in the heart of 30A with its restaurants, shopping, and much sought-after local entertainment.

• Dining Room overlooking the Gulf & Dunes (seats 8)
• Half Bathroom
• Access to second story infinity pool deck &

THIRD FLOOR:
• Media/Game Room with Shuffleboard & Shared Balcony
• Full Bathroom
• King Guest Suite with Shared Bathroom & Shared Balcony
• King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom
• Bunk Nook
• Laundry Room (Frontload Washer & Dryer) with Sink & Folding Counter

FOURTH FLOOR:
• Primary King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom and Shared Balcony
• King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom and Shared Balcony

CONVENIENT LOCATION:
-Rosemary Beach: Approximately 1.5 miles west. A picturesque community known for its unique architecture, boutique shops, and dining options.

-30Avenue: Approximately 1 mile north. An upscale shopping plaza with causal and fine dining estalishments.

-Seacrest Beach: Approximately 3 miles west. A family-friendly community with beautiful beaches and a relaxed atmosphere.

-Alys Beach: Approximately 3.5 miles west. Recognized for its striking white architecture and upscale amenities.

-The Big Chill: Approximately 5 miles west. A family friendly amphitheater with restaurants and shops.

-Grayton Beach: Approximately 12 miles west. Known for its artistic vibe and the nearby Grayton Beach State Park.

-Seaside: Approximately 10 miles west. Famous for its role in the movie "The Truman Show," featuring pastel-colored houses and a vibrant town center.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

This house does not allow a combo to the private beach but the view of the dunes and beach is beautiful.
